# Team-created revision fixtures

These files are team-created variations of the organizer `email_004_BL.txt`, not original organizer attachments or ground truth. Both replace the consignee and notify party with `EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC`. Version 2 changes gross weight to `130,058 KG`; version 3 restores `131,058 KG`. Other source content is preserved.

The revision API tests upload and parse these bytes normally; filenames do not select preset results.
